To measure exactly 45 minutes using the two ropes:  
1. Light **both ends** of the first rope (Rope A) and **one end** of the second rope (Rope B) at the same time.  
2. When Rope A is completely burned (after 30 minutes), immediately light the **other end** of Rope B.  
3. Rope B will now burn for an additional 15 minutes (since 30 minutes had already elapsed, and burning from both ends halves the remaining time).  
4. When Rope B is fully burned, exactly 45 minutes have passed.  

This method works because burning from both ends ensures consistent time calculation, regardless of the non-uniform burning rate. Safe.
